evidence.notes: Object-without-field state errors are catchable JSONException values and leave the generator usable.
Pending-field errors are catchable JSONException values without corrupting output state.
Root null object writes close as a valid root and reject later root writes.
Closed generator checks take precedence over raw JSON validation.
Accessor calls without a current token throw catchable JSONException.
Wrong-token accessors throw catchable JSONException and preserve parser position.
Invalid platform scalar parser access throws catchable JSONException.
Malformed JSON input throws catchable JSONException.
